mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS (easing) signals accommodative policy, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS declining.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in UNRATE below 4.5% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, reflecting improved labor market conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive when UNRATE crosses below 4.5%, or if returns revert in subsequent periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in INDPRO (supply index) over the next 60 trading days signals robust economic activity, driving equity valuations higher.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not rise significantly over 60 days, or 20-day returns are not positive despite sustained supply growth.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices over the next 5 trading days signals balanced economic expansion, driving equity valuations higher.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive despite both GDPC1 and INDPRO rising, or if they move in opposite directions.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 3.5% signals accommodative policy, boosting equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive when FEDFUNDS falls below 3.5% in late-cycle expansion, or if the regime isn't active.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in UNRATE below 4.0% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, reflecting improved labor market conditions.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not positive when UNRATE crosses below 4.0%, or if returns revert in subsequent periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in demand (GDPC1) and fall in FEDFUNDS (easing) over the next 60 trading days enhances economic activity and equity valuations.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not positive despite GDPC1 rising and FEDFUNDS falling, or if they move in opposite directions.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 2.5% signals policy accommodation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive when FEDFUNDS falls below 2.5% in post-shock recovery, or if the regime isn't active.
